title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maidragon: Valentine, Soshite Onsen! (Amari Kitai Shinaide Kudasai)
justification: AniList 98580 (OVA, 1 episode from 2017-09-20) is AniDB 12091's special S1 Valentine, Soshite Onsen! (Amari Kitai Shinaide Kudasai) (Valentines and Hot Springs! (Please Don't Get Your Hopes Up)), aired 2017-09-20. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 21776, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 12091, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji, English and native titles. The parent's row places S1 on TVDB 0x1 (2017-09-20) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 69291 S0E8 (2017-09-20).
